text_blocks.snippet: A COVID-19 rapid test, also known as a rapid antigen test, is a type of test that detects specific proteins (antigens) from the SARS-CoV-2 virus. These tests are designed to be convenient and accessible, often used as at-home tests. They are less sensitive than PCR tests, particularly early in an infection or in individuals without symptoms.

list.title: Antigen Detection:
list.snippet: Rapid tests identify antigens, which are substances that trigger an immune response, from the virus.

list.title: At-Home Convenience:
list.snippet: These tests are often available over-the-counter and can be self-administered at home.

list.title: Lower Sensitivity:
list.snippet: Compared to PCR tests, rapid antigen tests are less likely to detect the virus, especially in the early stages of infection or in people without symptoms.

list.title: Repeat Testing:
list.snippet: Because of their lower sensitivity, repeat testing (serial testing) is often recommended, especially for those with symptoms or exposure to the virus.
